shellCommands.command: for f in /workspace/pages/404.js /workspace/pages/_app.js /workspace/pages/_document.js /workspace/pages/_error.js /workspace/pages/index.js /workspace/pages/blog/index.js /workspace/pages/blog/[id].js /workspace/pages/api/posts/index.js '/workspace/pages/api/posts/[id].js' /workspace/components/AppProvider.js /workspace/styles/globals.css; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; done

grep -rn "cacheComponents" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js 2>/dev/null | head -5; node -e "const c = require('/workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.js'); console.log('default cacheComponents:', c.defaultConfig.cacheComponents)"

grep -n "revalidate" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/caching-without-cache-components.md | head -30; echo ---; grep -n "Route Segment Config" -A 40 /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/caching-without-cache-components.md | sed -n 1,60p

sed -n 1,70p /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/headers.md; echo '=== ISR ==='; grep -n "generateStaticParams\|export const revalidate\|notFound" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/incremental-static-regeneration.md | head -20

grep -n "405\|Method Not Allowed\|request.json()\|NextRequest" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/15-route-handlers.md | head; echo ===; grep -rn "dsc\|export const dynamic" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/caching-without-cache-components.md | sed -n 1,10p
npx next typegen 2>&1 | tail -5 && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -30

curl -s -A "TestAgent/1.0" localhost:3000/ | grep -o "user agent:.\{0,40\}"; curl -s localhost:3000/nope | grep -o "404 - Page Not Found" | head -1; curl -s localhost:3000/ | grep -c "font-inter"; pkill -f "next start" || true

grep -rl "font-inter" /workspace/.next/static 2>/dev/null | head -3; grep -o '"--font-inter[^,]*' /workspace/.next/server/app/index.html 2>/dev/null | head -2; grep -o 'class="[^"]*"' /workspace/.next/server/app/blog.html | head -1
git status --short && git diff tsconfig.json | head -20
